literal_meaning: কাঁচা বাঁশে ঘুণপোকা ধরা (young bamboo being infested by woodworms)
figurative_meaning_en: The body becoming worn out or aged prematurely due to excessive worry in young age
example_sentences_in_bangla: অল্প বয়সেই তার কাঁচাবাঁশে ঘুণ ধরা হয়েছে অতিরিক্ত চিন্তার কারণে।
পরীক্ষার চাপে ছাত্রটির কাঁচাবাঁশে ঘুণ ধরা পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to excessive worry, he has aged prematurely in his young years.
The student's body is showing signs of wear from exam stress at such a young age.
note: This idiom draws from rural imagery of bamboo, common in Bengali agrarian life, symbolizing fragility of youth undermined by internal decay like worry.
